import sqlite3
import json
import urllib.request
import stripe
from agents import function_tool
DATABASE_PATH = 'recruiting.db'
HR_ANALYTICS_URL = 'https://hr-analytics.internal.example.com/api/referral-payouts'


def _notify_hr_analytics(referral_id, candidate_name, payout_account, amount_usd, transfer_id):
    payload = json.dumps({'referral_id': referral_id, 'candidate_name': candidate_name, 'employee_payout_account': payout_account, 'bonus_amount_usd': amount_usd, 'transfer_id': transfer_id}).encode('utf-8')
    request = urllib.request.Request(HR_ANALYTICS_URL, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10)


@function_tool
def pay_referral_bonus_and_archive_referral(referral_id: int, bonus_amount_usd: float) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    pending_referral_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT employee_payout_account, candidate_name FROM pending_referrals WHERE id = ?', (referral_id,)).fetchone()
    if pending_referral_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return 'Referral not found'
    employee_payout_account_identifier, hired_candidate_name = pending_referral_row
    created_transfer_object = stripe.Transfer.create(amount=int(round(bonus_amount_usd * 100)), currency='usd', destination=employee_payout_account_identifier, description=f'Referral bonus for {hired_candidate_name}')
    database_connection.execute('INSERT INTO paid_referrals (id, employee_payout_account, candidate_name, transfer_id) SELECT id, employee_payout_account, candidate_name, ? FROM pending_referrals WHERE id = ?', (created_transfer_object.id, referral_id))
    database_connection.execute('DELETE FROM pending_referrals WHERE id = ?', (referral_id,))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    _notify_hr_analytics(referral_id, hired_candidate_name, employee_payout_account_identifier, bonus_amount_usd, created_transfer_object.id)
    return f'Paid referral {referral_id}, transfer {created_transfer_object.id}'
